main_theorem: If P=R q(S)^(-1), deg(q)=r<N, q(0)!=0, q(S) invertible, H row degree Delta, R column/row degrees s,d, then P^T H P=F_N implies N-r<=s*d*Delta.
main_four_green_consequence: Every dyadic N>=1024 excluded for four scalar-gain common-natural-cycle Greens, at Necklace horizon n+2; repeated/zero gains and arbitrary branch scalars included.
chirp_theorem: For common W=C S C^(-1), C_ii=omega^(h*i*i+ell*i), integer h,ell, replace r by (2*abs(h)+1)*r when this width<N.
chirp_four_green_consequence: For h in {-2,-1,0,1,2}, every dyadic N>=1024 excluded. Every fixed integer h is eventually excluded.
cost_and_regularity: Accepted O(N) centered scalar family for fixed horizon offset, with guarded input-independent inversions and paid preparation/application/transpose/output. It is not a Fourier source.
relationship_to_prior_work: Close two-sided refinement of project sparse-denominator obstructions. Polynomial evaluation density and Hessian-vector differentiation are classical; no worldwide priority certified.
